newsitem.title: USA: Unocal joins Occidental natural gas venture.
newsitem.headline: Unocal joins Occidental natural gas venture.

text.p: Unocal Corp said Thursday it will join a natural gas production-sharing agreement held by Occidental Petroleum Corp covering three million acres in northeast Bangladesh.
Unocal will take a 50 percent stake in the joint venture, the company said in a statement.
Under the agreement, the companies plan to explore and develope the Jalalabad field in Bangladesh over the next two years.
Production is targeted to begin in mid-1998, the company said. In addition, the joint venture will drill four exploration wells in the area covered by Blocks 12, 13 and 14 over the next three years.
The company said natural gas demand in Bangladesh is expected to more than double from its current level over the next 10 to 15 years.
